mainEntity.name: What does Google Ads management include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Ads management at O3M covers planning, running and improving your Google Ads (PPC) campaigns across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display, Remarketing and Shopping. Before optimising, we set up the measurement behind them: conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, GA4, CRM integration and call tracking. After launch we keep reviewing search terms, keywords, audience signals, ad creatives, landing pages, conversion performance and budget allocation, and we look at lead quality and sales follow-up alongside the campaigns, so decisions are based on business results rather than clicks.

mainEntity.name: How does O3M decide which campaign types to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We start from your objectives, how your customers buy, what makes a lead worth following up and your sales process, then choose the campaign types that fit. Most businesses start with Search, because it reaches people already looking for what they sell. Performance Max, YouTube, Display and Remarketing are added when they support a clear goal, such as reaching buyers earlier or re-engaging visitors who are still comparing options. Ecommerce brands usually add Shopping. We don't run every campaign type by default.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure and improve lead quality from Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: We first agree with you what counts as a good enquiry, then track form and phone enquiries with conversion tracking, enhanced conversions, GA4 and CRM integration, depending on what your systems allow. Lead quality and sales follow-up are reviewed with you alongside campaign data. When enquiries are poor, we look at the whole chain: the search terms and keywords that triggered them, the ad promise, the landing page and form, and how quickly leads are followed up, rather than changing bids in isolation.

mainEntity.name: How does O3M generate and improve qualified B2B enquiries through Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: We focus campaigns on the searches business buyers make for products, specifications, suppliers and technical solutions, and keep the ad message and landing page aligned so the right companies enquire. Forms and landing pages are reviewed so enquiries carry enough detail for your sales team to qualify them. Because B2B purchases involve technical evaluation, several decision-makers and longer cycles, we review lead quality with you over time and use remarketing for buyers still comparing options. Manufacturing and industrial marketing is one of O3M's core focus areas; see how O3M markets manufacturing and industrial businesses.

mainEntity.name: Can O3M manage Google Ads for an ecommerce store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. For ecommerce brands, D2C businesses and marketplace sellers we use Shopping ads, Performance Max and remarketing to reach people searching to buy, and measure campaigns on orders, revenue and advertising efficiency rather than traffic. Spend is shifted toward the products and campaigns that sell. Accurate purchase tracking is set up first, because automated bidding learns from it. See how O3M supports ecommerce and marketplace growth.

mainEntity.name: What role does AdFlux play in how O3M manages campaigns?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdFlux is O3M's own marketing performance and revenue-operations platform. It brings campaign data together with lead management, CRM activity and sales execution, so our team can see which campaigns lead to real opportunities, where leads are lost, and what to improve next, from campaign changes to CRM follow-up. It is designed to work with your CRM and sales pipeline data without replacing your existing tools. How it applies to your account depends on the data you can share; see how AdFlux works.

mainEntity.name: Should we hire a Google Ads agency or manage it in-house?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on how much specialist time you have: an agency gives you people who manage Google Ads every day and keep their certifications current, while your own team knows the business best. Many businesses combine the two. Your team owns the goals, lead qualification and sales follow-up, and O3M runs the campaigns, measurement and ongoing optimisation. Either way, campaigns work best when marketing and sales review the same lead-quality information.

mainEntity.name: How much should we spend on Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right budget is set by your industry, competition, the value of a customer and your growth goals, so we look at those in a discovery conversation before recommending a starting point. A useful way to frame it is how many qualified enquiries or sales you need and what each one is worth to you. You don't need to share a budget to enquire: the spend field in the form is optional.

mainEntity.name: What should we prepare before starting Google Ads with O3M?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps to share your business objectives, the products or services you want to grow, how you define a qualified lead, and how your sales team follows up enquiries. If you already run campaigns, access to your Google Ads account, GA4 and any CRM data lets us review what is working. Don't worry if tracking isn't in place yet: setting up measurement is one of the first things we do.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with businesses in Chennai and Coimbatore?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. O3M has offices in Chennai (T. Nagar) and Coimbatore (Saibaba Colony) and works with businesses across India and selected international markets. Campaigns, reporting and reviews can all be handled remotely, and you can contact the O3M team by phone on +91 9500 123 131 or by email at info@o3mdm.com.
